ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Rimout Power Suit
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.7
Walking tanks for your colonists. A power suit is a hulking armoured frame that stands on its own until a colonist climbs inside to work and fight in it, and climbs back out when the job is done.
A pilot in a power suit can wield the heavy warcasket weapons from Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates. Unlike a warcasket, nobody is welded in for life.
Early build: the suit frame, climbing in and out, and warcasket weapon support. Power cells and charging racks, swappable suit modules and wrecked suits that trap their pilot are on the way.
Requires Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates.
